column1: # §4.7 — Long file load runs on a background task; user sees WAIT
# mode + a "Loading <basename>" hint on line 3 while it runs; on
# completion, mode returns to READY. Atomic-journal undo of a
# wholesale /File Retrieve is intentionally out of scope per
# §4.3 ("file ops are NOT undone, consistent with 1-2-3"); that
# guarantee belongs to M11 /File Import where the load writes into
# a range rather than swapping the workbook.
# Seed a workbook with a known cell and save it to disk.
# Dirty A1 in-memory so we can prove the retrieve actually pulled
# Park the next async op so the transcript can observe mid-flight
# WAIT state. In production this is the natural state of any load
# that takes longer than one render tick.
# /FR <path><ENTER> — queues the load and returns immediately.
# Mid-flight: WAIT indicator is visible, line 3 names the file
# being loaded, and the in-memory state is untouched.
# Drain the parked op to completion.
# Mode pops back to READY and A1 is the saved 42 again.
